attchmntText: Fineotex Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Abans Enterprises Limited has placed two resolutions before members for approval via postal ballot through remote e-voting. The first is a special resolution to approve the disposal of the undertaking or assets of Abans Gems and Jewels Trading FZC, a step-down subsidiary. The second is an ordinary resolution to approve material related party transactions between Abans Jewels Limited and Abans Middle East FZCO. The cut-off date for voting rights is November 06, 2026. Remote e-voting commenced on November 13, 2026, and ends on December 12, 2026. Ms. Rachana Shanbhag has been appointed as the scrutinizer. Results will be announced within two working days after the conclusion of e-voting.

attchmntText: Fineotex Chemical Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Fineotex Chemical Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Consolidated Total Income from Operations increased by 169.14% to Rs. 391.41 crore for the quarter and by 166.81% to Rs. 778.13 crore for the half year. Consolidated Operating EBITDA rose by approximately 92.04% to Rs. 59.59 crore quarterly and by approximately 111.22% to Rs. 118.74 crore half-yearly. Consolidated Profit After Tax increased by 70.82% to Rs. 44.55 crore for the quarter and by 81.51% to Rs. 92.75 crore for the half year. Consolidated business volumes grew by approximately 132.30%. The Statutory Auditors issued unqualified Limited Review Reports on the results.

attchmntText: Fineotex Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Fineotex Chemical Limited has scheduled an investor and analyst conference call for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. The virtual meeting will discuss operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27. Participants include Dr. Aarti Jhunjhunwala, Mr. Sanjay Tibrewala, Mr. Arindam Choudhuri, and Mr. Yusuf K Contractor. Access is available via primary numbers plus 91 22 6280 1578 and plus 91 22 7115 8899, or toll-free lines for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. A Diamond Pass link is also provided. RSVP details are managed by Adfactors PR.
